capabilities: Extract entries from daily notes into a time-organized timeline
Visualize writing consistency with an activity heatmap
Compute recording stats such as total days, streaks and peak days
Browse tags ranked by usage frequency with per-tag visual styles
Play ambient background sounds (rain, rivers, birds)
disambiguation: Not an audio recorder despite the name; it extracts written entries from daily notes, not voice recordings.
extras: README is bilingual (English and Simplified Chinese); manual installation requires copying an audio folder alongside the plugin files.
problem: Obsidian has no at-a-glance, stylized view of past daily-note entries and writing habits like streaks, peak days and tag frequency.
summary: Retro-terminal style dashboard that turns daily notes into an inner-monologue timeline with heatmap, streak stats, a tag registry and ambient sounds.
